# Novlr

> > Novlr is a writer-owned creative writing workspace designed to support authors through every stage of their writing journey, from drafting and editing to publishing and audience building.

Novlr is a comprehensive platform built by and for writers, offering distraction-free writing tools, community features, educational resources, and publishing support. The platform emphasizes writer ownership, community collaboration, and helping authors achieve their creative goals.
